Ana (Vendor Ops): Heads-up: CloudNode sent invoice CN-0624 with both a DE VAT number and a note saying 'reverse charge where applicable'. Theyre asking us to confirm our VAT ID so they can zero-rate. Invoice PDF: https://files.redwood/cloudnode/CN-0624.pdf

Marta (Finance): We need to confirm the invoicing entity and whether Redwood can assert an EU VAT ID for reverse charge. If we don't have a valid EU VAT, vendor should charge VAT. Can you paste the invoice header?

Sébastien (CloudNode): Hi team  it's CloudNode GmbH (DE). We billed CN-0624 from our German office but the service is provided cross-border to Redwood EU customers. We applied domestic German VAT by mistake on the PDF and can reissue net if you can provide an EU VAT ID or confirm business status. We're happy to reissue.

Jon (Tax): Two quick points: (1) Reverse-charge in EU requires the buyer to be VAT-registered in an EU member state and to provide a valid VAT ID. (2) If Redwood is a non-EU entity (no EU VAT), then domestic VAT should stand. We need to know which legal entity of Redwood is the contracting party and whether it has an EU VAT registration.

Ana (Vendor Ops): Contract shows bill-to: Redwood Inference Inc. (US). Do we have an EU VAT for Redwood?

Marta (Finance): Redwood global ops: primary legal entity is US-incorporated. We have a separate EU subsidiary for some customers but this engagement is with the US entity. No EU VAT on this purchase order.

vies-bot: VIES check: DE123456789 -> STATUS: VALID (checked 2026-06-24 08:45 UTC).

Sébastien (CloudNode): Ah, thanks. Our German VAT is valid. If Redwood Inference Inc. is the buyer (US), we should have charged German VAT — that explains the tax line. We only zero-rate if buyer provides an EU VAT ID. We can reissue either way; prefer net if you have an EU VAT.

Luca (AP): Invoice will remain on hold until we have clarity. Hold code: TAX_VAT_REVIEW. If vendor reissues net we still need a credit memo for the VAT amount. Also need bank/crypto payout legal name.

Jon (Tax): Confirmed: if the contracting party is Redwood Inference Inc. (US) and no EU VAT ID is supplied, CloudNode should charge German VAT. No action on our side to assert reverse-charge. If vendor wants to reissue net, they must confirm that the buyer is an EU-registered entity (provide VIES link) and provide a corrected invoice with reference to Article 196 (reverse charge).

Sébastien (CloudNode): Understood. We will reissue two documents: (1) corrected invoice charging the German VAT (as originally issued) and (2) optional reissued net invoice if you can provide an EU VAT number. We'll include a credit note if needed. We'll also attach company extract and VAT verification.

Marta (Finance): Good. AP: once we receive reissued invoice(s) + any credit memo and the payout legal name, we'll process. For now keep hold.

Luca (AP): Noted. I'll wait for the reissued files uploaded to ap-docs@redwood and then reconcile VAT lines.

Sébastien (CloudNode): Files uploaded: CN-0624-creditnote.pdf and CN-0624-net-invoice.pdf. We did not receive an EU VAT for Redwood yet so net invoice is pending your confirmation.

vies-bot: VIES check: (no buyer VAT supplied) -> buyer VAT missing.

Jon (Tax): Thanks. Since no EU VAT from Redwood, AP should pay the gross invoice (VAT included) or ask vendor to reapply VAT via credit note and reissue gross. But vendor already provided credit note and net invoice; we need to decide which to accept. Given contracting party is US, we should accept the gross (with VAT) unless commercial prefers net and Redwood can provide EU VAT for billing.

Marta (Finance): We'll proceed to pay the gross invoice to avoid delays. Vendor can keep the net invoice on file if Redwood later provides an EU VAT ID for future invoices. Luca please release payment once AP verifies the VAT amount matches the tax line and bank/crypto payout legal name matches the vendor docs.

Luca (AP): Will do. Releasing hold after verifying uploaded credit note/invoice and vendor bank/crypto payout name. Please tag ap-docs@redwood when anything new is uploaded.

Sébastien (CloudNode): Thanks all. We'll keep net invoice on file for future EU-registered customers. No gross-up requested. :thumbsup:

Marta (Finance): Closing this thread when payment completes. Thanks everyone.
